physicalNotes: Radius 1.30 +/- 0.01 Jupiter radii, temperature 770 +/- 75 K and mass 3.75 +/- 0.5 Jupiter masses: the evolutionary-model row (Saumon & Marley 2008 hybrid clouds, 24 +/- 3 Myr) of Balmer et al. (2025, arXiv:2411.05917), Table 4: 92,939.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. Their atmosphere fits give radii from 0.5 to 1.8 Jupiter radii and temperatures from 760 to 1260 K, the 'radius problem' of their section 5, so the evolutionary values are used. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
